subject: history
concept: Understanding what happened when explorers encountered indigenous peoples, presenting multiple perspectives honestly
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth and multi-perspective principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares an account of an encounter from an explorer's perspective and from an indigenous perspective
exercise.pictorial: Student matches key outcomes of these encounters (trade, conflict, disease, cultural exchange) to real historical examples
exercise.abstract: Student describes the encounter honestly, referencing at least two different real effects it had

misconception_flags: presents only one perspective or omits the real, difficult consequences of these encounters

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
